challenge.method: Extract the Fair passage from the visible main-element text, the standalone SPDX file, and decoded JSON licenseText. Lowercase and tokenize maximal ASCII letter-or-digit runs. Compare the ordered sequences, check the whole SPDX text values for equality, then expand the boundary to test the effect of the placeholder and title. Match the annotated tag's commit target to both SPDX URL paths.
challenge.results: All three bounded sequences contain 34 tokens in the same order with zero mismatches. The two complete SPDX text values are identical. Including the placeholder yields 36 tokens in the project main element. The complete SPDX text values yield 38 tokens because they also include the Fair License title. The raw HTML passage has markup and line breaks. Both pinned SPDX paths match the annotated tag's commit target.

limitations: The tag object is unsigned. The release binding rests on the repository API response and exact commit-pinned data URLs.
The standalone file and detail are two representations from one SPDX revision. Their agreement establishes consistency within that revision.
The comparison excludes the copyright placeholder, title, and separate commentary or proposals. It establishes bounded text correspondence without dating adoption or determining legal effect.
reasoning: The publisher passage and both SPDX representations share the exact ordered sequence under the stated tokenization. The repository tag object binds both SPDX artifacts to release 3.29.0.
